prompt: Here's the token-bucket rate limiter we use in front of the notification-sending service to keep per-user, per-channel send rates within limits (so we don't get our sending IP or carrier blocked by SMS/email/push providers). It was written and tested on a single local instance and the tests pass cleanly there. In production we run this behind a load balancer as N horizontally-scaled replicas, and operators are now reporting that some users blow well past their intended send limit — and that limits seem to "reset" right after every deploy. Walk me through the code: what's actually going wrong once we scale out, why didn't the single-instance test ever catch it, how severe is this, and what's the correct fix (and how would you test that fix)?
